title: Qwen3.8-27B: 127 Tok/s on One RTX 3090
status: 2026-10-12: original script based on checked primary sources (Hugging Face model card + HF API facts) and clearly attributed third-party benchmarks (HyperQwen, community reports); approved Option 3 flow voice; no on-screen credits. | On-screen browser chrome shows a concise source domain; full source URLs stay in descriptions.
credits_on_screen: Screens: own capture of the Qwen3.8-27B model page (huggingface.co). Demo frames: official media from that model card. Speed figures are HyperQwen's published benchmarks, not our own measurement.
verify_before_render: HF API read 2026-10-12: 17,529 likes; 6,843,108 downloads (30 days); Apache-2.0; ~27.8B parameters; image-text-to-text. Speed claims are attributed: HyperQwen's published benchmarks (127 tok/s single-stream, 381 tok/s when quoting its prompt, ~1,035 tok/s aggregate at 64 concurrent, 250 W RTX 3090); community reports commonly land lower (roughly 40-75 tok/s). Not presented as our independent test.
No on-screen credit captions. Option 3 Chatterbox Michael continuous-flow voice required.

scenes.heading: QWEN3.8-27B ON ONE *RTX 3090*
scenes.say: A twenty seven billion parameter model, running at home, on a single used graphics card.
{Qwen3.8-27B|Qwen three point eight, twenty seven B} is in Hugging Face's top ten right now, with seventeen thousand five hundred likes and millions of downloads.

scenes.heading: ONE CARD, *ONE STREAM*
scenes.label: 1x RTX 3090 at 250 W · HyperQwen benchmark
scenes.say: The headline number: {127|one hundred and twenty seven} tokens per second, single stream, on one 3090, at two hundred fifty watts.

scenes.heading: WHAT YOU *GET*
steps: Takes images as well as text
scenes.say: You get a 27.8 billion parameter model under Apache 2.0 that also takes images, with context up to a hundred fifty thousand tokens on a 24 gig card.

scenes.heading: READ THE *FINE PRINT*
cons: 127 tok/s needs the tuned vLLM build
scenes.say: The catch: one twenty seven needs the tuned build; stock setups report forty to seventy five. It is quantized hard to fit. But there is no per-token bill, and at sixty four parallel requests it aggregates over a thousand.

scenes.heading: AND IT *TAKES IMAGES* TOO
scenes.say: It is not text only. The same checkpoint accepts images, so screenshots and photos work locally.
Would you run a 27B model at home? Comment Qwen and I will pin the benchmark.

youtube.title: Qwen3.8-27B: 127 Tok/s on One RTX 3090
youtube.description:
Qwen3.8-27B runs on a single used RTX 3090: 127 tokens per second single-stream at 250 W in HyperQwen's published vLLM benchmark, ~1,035 tok/s aggregate across 64 concurrent requests, and up to 150k context on 24 GB. Stock setups often report 40-75 tok/s, so tuning matters. The model is Apache-2.0, ~27.8B parameters, and takes images as well as text. Facts checked 12 October 2026.
Source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
